Here are the Batch Client Extension files.

=== FILE: client-extensions/book-object/client-extension.yaml ===
assemble:
    - from: batch
      into: batch
book-batch:
    name: Book Object Initialization
    oAuthApplicationHeadlessServer: book-oauth
    type: batch
book-oauth:
    .serviceAddress: localhost:8080
    .serviceScheme: http
    name: Book OAuth Headless Server
    type: oAuthApplicationHeadlessServer
=== END FILE ===

=== FILE: `client-extensions/book-object/batch/01-00-folder-definition.batch-engine-data.json` ===

    "configuration": {
        "className": "com.liferay.object.admin.rest.dto.v1_0.ObjectFolder"

=== END FILE ===
